name: The right files in view, nothing risky read
principle: A piece of work starts with the files it needs in view and nothing that is dependency, build output, cache or a secret.
state_description: Asking for work in a folder of thousands of files shows a handful of files the goal points at, the folders left out are listed with their reason so they can be asked for, and no credential or private file is read unless a person decides.
hints_of_measurement: The needed files among the first shown within a budget, the share of the budget spent on others, picks in risky or trap folders, and the share of left-out folders reported.
